hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I slipped through the shadows of our London manor, the tallow candle glowing with a flickering life in my hand. The door, heavy and laden with locks, creaked open as I felt my way through the cold linen walls. I was in my secret chamber, my drafty attic, where I wrote my diary by candlelight.
caption:
Caught in the shadows, I sought solace in my attic chamber, where I poured my heart into my diary.
